name: Good Wife
overview: Scripture presents the role of a good wife as a divine blessing and a vital support to her husband and household. From Genesis 2:18, God created the wife as a suitable helper for man, emphasizing her essential partnership. Proverbs highlights her value as a virtuous woman who brings honor like a crown to her husband and wisely builds her home, contrasting her with folly that destroys it. Finding a good wife is described as obtaining favor from the Lord, and her worth is praised as being far above rubies, underscoring the godly character and prudence that mark her.
